Conversation Bench
	

75-turn multi-turn speech-to-speech benchmark for evaluating voice AI models as a conference assistant for the AI Engineer World's Fair.
Part of Audio Arena, a suite of 6 benchmarks spanning 221 turns across different domains. Built by Arcada Labs.
